svg.title: VPNGUARD-X evidence-bounded and constraint-guided IPsec security assurance architecture
svg.desc: A research architecture showing passive and cooperative inputs, evidence-status tagging, protocol parsing, observability, machine-learning baselines, the CGII constrained posterior, standards-based policy assessment, risk intervals, counterfactual remediation, and a controlled strongSwan cyber-range.

g.text: No unsupported parameter claims • ambiguity is preserved
PCAP or authorized live capture only
No decryption • no endpoint secrets • passive evidence boundary
Validates passive inference and establishes scenario ground truth
Evidence contract — every reported property carries one status
CO = { c ∈ C : c is consistent with O
Abstain / UNKNOWN • never force a point prediction
Automated strongSwan scenarios • isolated environments only • 1:1 PCAP ↔ machine-readable ground truth
IKEv2 + legacy IKEv1 • tunnel / transport • cipher / AEAD
KE + PFS • IPv4 / IPv6 • native ESP / NAT-T
WEB • VIDEO • VOIP • BULK/FILE • CHAT • CONTROL • UNKNOWN
LO-configuration / cipher / mode • cross-stack if feasible
OOD apps • packet loss 10% / 30% / 50% • incomplete PCAP
Every security rule stores: rule ID → normative source/section → evidence predicate → rationale → remediation
Current strongSwan documentation anchors implementation-specific validation.
Future-ready: IKEv2 multiple key exchanges + hybrid classical/ML-KEM; optional module, not the sole novelty.
All empirical performance values: TBD — requires experiment
